en.name: GadgetNest
en.subtitle: For anyone buying a gadget
en.short_description: Early access. Not yet connected to any retailer, so no products or prices show.
en.description:
GadgetNest is being built to compare gadget prices across retailers, delivery included. It is not there yet, and this version says so instead of pretending.

WHAT THIS VERSION DOES
GadgetNest is not connected to any retailer price feed yet. It lists no products and shows no prices. Every screen that would show one says plainly that live prices are unavailable, rather than showing a number someone made up.

SETTINGS
Choose light, dark or system appearance, read the privacy policy and terms, and erase everything the app stores on your device with one button.

STRAIGHT ANSWERS
GadgetNest has no affiliate agreement with any retailer and earns nothing from outbound links. It takes no payment and has no account or sign-in. If the app crashes it sends a crash report, which carries no name or account and is not linked to you.

ADS
GadgetNest shows ads from Google AdMob: a banner on its main screens and an occasional full-screen ad between tabs. Google may use device identifiers to serve and measure ads. The app does not ask to track you and does not use the advertising identifier, and where the law requires consent (such as the EEA and UK) ads are requested only after you choose; you can change that choice in Settings > Privacy choices.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
GadgetNest is being built to compare gadget prices across retailers, delivery included. It is not there yet, and this version says so instead of pretending.

Intended audience:
For anyone buying a gadget

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. The app opens on Home. The bottom bar reaches Home, Browse, Deals, My list and Saved; Settings is the gear icon at the top of Home.
This build is not connected to a retailer price feed, so there are no products to open, compare, save or add to a list. Browse lists the gadget categories; opening a category, searching, Deals, My list and Saved each say so with an empty state, and any screen that would show a price says "Live prices are unavailable" instead of a number.
What works in this build: choosing light, dark or system appearance, opening the privacy policy and terms, and Settings > Erase everything stored.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Firebase (Google) — app initialisation
- Firebase Crashlytics (Google) — crash reporting
- Google AdMob (ads) — a banner above the tab bar on Home, Browse, Deals, My list, Saved and category lists, and an occasional frequency-capped interstitial between tabs. Non-tracking: no ATT prompt and no advertising ID; Google may use device identifiers to serve and measure ads. Ads are requested only after Google's UMP consent check allows it, and Settings shows a Privacy choices row where Google's consent message applies (EEA, UK, Switzerland).
- Crashlytics crash reports: each report carries the stack trace, device model, OS and app version and a random Crashlytics installation identifier; no name, account or usage data.
- Firebase Analytics, Performance Monitoring and Remote Config are linked into the binary through our shared crash-reporting package but are never initialised by this app; Analytics and Performance collection are also switched off in Info.plist and AndroidManifest.xml.
- No retailer API, no sign-in and no backend. The privacy policy and terms links open in the device browser.

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app follows the device language for 12 locales (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish), but translation is partial: shared labels are translated, while most screen text is in English only. Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.

8. LANGUAGES (CLARIFIES SECTION 6)
The app declares the 12 locales listed in section 6, and its shared labels (three of the five tab names, the Settings title, and some buttons and empty-state titles) are translated into them. Most screen text in this build is still English only, so outside English the app is partly translated. Features do not differ by language or region.

9. STATE OF THIS BUILD
GadgetNest is not yet connected to any retailer price feed. It shows no products, no prices and no deals, and it says so on every screen that would show them. It contains no sample or placeholder products presented as real.

differentiation:
1. WHAT IT DOES
GadgetNest is for the part of buying a gadget that happens before you buy it. This version is not yet connected to a retailer price feed, so it lists no products or prices.
Screens it contains: browse, build list, compare, deals, home, product, saved, settings

2. INTENDED USER
People about to buy a consumer gadget who want to compare prices across retailers, delivery included, before they buy. This version is not connected to any retailer price feed, lists no products and shows no prices, and says so on every screen that would show one; today it offers nothing to that user beyond appearance settings and a data-erase button. The audience is stated as the one it is being built for, not one it currently serves.

5. STANDALONE OR PART OF A SUITE
Part of a suite: 43 apps are published under this developer account.
Category: SHOPPING.

This app's scope differs from the rest measurably, not just by description:

  - Screens unique to it: build list, product
  - Closest other app by implementation: FashionFactory at 76%
    similarity of non-generic widget and class usage
  - Across all 43 apps the median pairwise similarity is 15%, and
    no pair exceeds 85%

Both numbers exclude the ~60 widgets every Flutter app uses — Column, Text,
Padding and so on. Including them makes any two Flutter apps look 97% alike,
which is a property of the framework rather than of these apps.

The store copy is distinct on the same basis: no two of the 43 share more
than 22% of their description vocabulary.

7. CODE SHARED WITH OUR OTHER APPS
Yes, infrastructure only: agl_i18n (shared translations); agl_observability (crash reporting); agl_ads (Google AdMob ads behind consent). It has no sign-in and does not use Supabase or any other backend. No screens, features or content are shared; the similarity figure in 5 measures exactly that.

8. CODE SHARED WITH THIRD-PARTY APPS
No, beyond standard third-party frameworks: firebase_core, firebase_crashlytics, flutter_localizations, flutter_riverpod, go_router, shared_preferences, url_launcher, google_mobile_ads via agl_ads (and, via agl_observability, firebase_analytics, firebase_performance and firebase_remote_config, which this app does not initialise).
